## Spacing Scale

Declared values (must be multiples of 4):

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon gaps in the status line |
| sm | 8px | Stacked lines inside a card |
| md | 16px | Card padding on narrow screens |
| lg | 24px | Card padding on desktop; gap between cards |
| xl | 32px | Page padding on desktop |
| 2xl | 48px | Not used this phase |
| 3xl | 64px | Not used this phase |

Exceptions:
- **Live-status dot tap target: 44px minimum**, reached with padding around the icon and label.
- **Top bar height: 56px**, a computed value on the 4px grid.

---

## Layout

- **Page container:** max-width 1100px, centred, side padding `lg` below 640px and `xl` at or above it.
- **Top bar:** fixed 56px; wordmark on the left, live-status dot on the right.
- **Shed grid:** one column below 640px, two at or above it, in a fixed order that never sorts by state.
- **Card layout (top to bottom):**
  1. Header row: shed name and a status icon
  2. Stock bar and percentage
  3. Count line
  4. Status line
  5. Freshness stamp

## Color

Values come from the initialized preset's stylesheet, light mode first, dark mode in its own column. **Use the CSS variables, never these hex values, in code.**

| Role | Value (light) | Value (dark) | Usage |
|------|------|------|-------|
| Dominant (60%) | `--background` #F9F7EC | #12201A | Page background |
| Secondary (30%) | `--secondary`/`--muted` #EFEBDD, `--border` #DDD8C6 | `--card` #1B2C24 | Card border, top bar surface, skeleton fill |
| Accent (10%) | `--primary` #2F6B45 | `--primary` #6DBE8C | Stock bar fill on healthy cards, live-status icon |
| Destructive | `--destructive` #B8412A | #E9806B | Low-stock card border and header, its bar fill, the offline icon |

**Accent reserved for:** the stock bar fill on healthy cards and the live-status icon only.

### Non-color state redundancy (accessibility requirement)

Each shed's state uses three channels at once, never color alone:

| State | Icon (lucide) | Card treatment | Status-line text |
|-------|----------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| healthy | `CircleCheck` | Normal border | "COUNT MATCHES SHELF" |
| low | `TriangleAlert` | Destructive border and header | A required reason, such as "3 drills missing since Friday" |
| silent | `Unplug` | Greyed card, last values kept | "no report — last seen 14:32" |

---

## Motion & Reduced-Motion Contract

- The stock bar eases its width over about 200ms and snaps under reduced motion.
- The live-status dot pulses once when it reconnects and stays still under reduced motion.

---

## Screen-Reader / Live-Region Contract

- A frequently changing percentage is not a live region.
- A shed moving from healthy to low is announced once, politely.

---

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Waiting caption | **"Waiting for the first count…"** |
| Silent line | **"no report — last seen {time}"** |

---

## UI Considerations

> Empty- and error-state **copy** is owned by `## Copywriting Contract` above; this section covers
> shape-rooted **state** coverage and points at those rows.

### E1 — Shed card grid (`list-collection`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | With no sheds the page shows one explanatory line. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Four skeleton cards in the real card frame. |
| error | ✅ covered | One alert above the grid with a retry. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Cards in fixed order, two columns from 640px. |
| partial | ✅ covered | A shed with no count yet shows a skeleton card among real ones. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Extra sheds wrap into new rows. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | One card sits in the first column. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Shed names truncate with a title. |

### E2 — Shed card (`list-collection`, `static-content`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A shed with zero tools reads "0 tools" with an empty bar. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Skeleton blocks in the card frame. |
| error | ✅ covered | A silent shed greys out and keeps its last values. |
| populated | ✅ covered | The five-line anatomy above. |
| partial | ✅ covered | A missing status line falls back to the stamp alone. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Lines wrap; the card grows downward only. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | "1 tool" and "N tools" share one template. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Reasons wrap inside the card. |

### E3 — Status line and reason line (`static-content`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A healthy shed shows the fixed healthy text. |
| error | ✅ covered | A low shed always shows a reason. |
| populated | ✅ covered | One line, one colour channel plus icon and text. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The line wraps to two lines. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Reasons are clipped at the source to one sentence. |
| loading | ✅ covered | The line is part of the skeleton. |

### E4 — Stock bar (`media`, `static-content` — user-confirmed override)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Zero percent shows the bare track. |
| loading | ✅ covered | A skeleton bar. |
| error | ✅ covered | The bar greys with the card. |
| populated | ✅ covered | A solid track with a fill. |
| partial | ✅ covered | A count with no total shows no bar. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Values above 100 percent clamp to the full track. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | The label reads the same at every count. |

### E5 — Live-status dot (`nav`, `media`, `interactive-control`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Before the first message the dot reads "Connecting". |
| loading | ✅ covered | "Reconnecting…" with a still icon under reduced motion. |
| error | ✅ covered | "Offline" with the destructive icon. |
| populated | ✅ covered | "Live" with the accent icon. |
| partial | ✅ covered | A stale connection reads "Reconnecting…". |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The label hides below 640px; the icon stays. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | The label is a fixed set. |
